versions.changelog:
**Expanded to cover all five US government data sources in one skill.**

- Added support for federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov), USAspending awards, Grants.gov funding, and US House STOCK Act trades, alongside SEC EDGAR fundamentals.
- Now offers nine tools covering contracts, awards, grants, congressional trades, financial statements, ratios, company profiles, and filings.
- Updated authentication, usage guidance, and pricing to reflect broader coverage and credit weighting by endpoint.
- Removed the skill card documentation file; added main handler file for new functionality.
- Usage notes specify this skill now handles both financials and federal government data for US entities.

First full release: clean, parsed SEC EDGAR data for US-listed companies via Edgrapi.

- Four tools: get normalized fundamentals, computed ratios, company profiles, and recent SEC filings for any US-listed ticker
- Parses and normalizes complex EDGAR XBRL filings into easy-to-use JSON
- Robust error handling with clear diagnostic messages
- Requires an Edgrapi API key (free tier available)
- Designed to avoid unnecessary calls; triggers only for explicit, real financial data requests
